$comment: Each body's chosen teacher and the conditions every tracker of that body trains and runs under.
conditions: environment variables of the body's tracking task (paths relative to the repository).
teacher: the run tag of the chosen teacher (logs/rsl_rl/<body>_track/<stamp>_<tag>_<body>, latest
checkpoint); symmetrised: the teacher is that checkpoint averaged with its mirror image
(symmetrize_actor.py, exported as model_<n>_sym_pact.pt). Chosen by the final teacher audit
(transfer/scripts/pact_teacher_final_read.py): one recipe for every body, entropy 0 and symmetrised;
Cassie's run carries the corrected sole card (contactsole).
variant: the teacher's name in the audit (pact_teacher_audit.sh): its captures
logs/pact/teachers/<body>_<variant>_{probes,train}.npz are the base data of every arm.
rollouts: where a body's evaluation captures are written; mirror: its joint mirror map.
transfer/scripts/body_conditions.py turns an entry into shell assignments.
